category: ui-illustration (asset-free, hand-authored; no form category covers an invented product UI and the webpage category requires a real capture)
style: Calm product-UI illustration in the PostRiff app language: white cards on near-white (or dark cards on near-black), 12px radius, hairline borders, soft shadow, one monochrome accent. No metrics, names, handles or logos.
export: png-sequence master -> mp4 (H.264 yuv420p faststart) + webm (VP9) + first-frame jpg, per theme

beats.motion: typed prompt on two lines (prefix-measured clip reveal + caret), one caret blink, send press with ring
composer rises 134px; three drafts slide out from under it with a small fan rotation, 40ms stagger; placeholder lines draw in; time chips and pills appear
Approve pill pressed on LinkedIn then Instagram; label swaps to a drawn check + Approved; Threads stays Draft (dashed, no time)
composer closes, week calendar opens in its place; approved cards shrink into Wednesday 4pm (Instagram) and 5pm (LinkedIn) slot chips
calendar and Threads close fast; empty composer reopens and holds, matching frame 0
